## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

## Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

- Critical lifts includes any tandem lift, lifting a load over buildings or close to overhead electrical power lines and where the SWL exceeds 75% of the rated capacity ofthe crane. Lift plans for critical liftsaretobereviewedbyEMAARMisr.
- Lifting accessories (chain/web/SWR slings, shackles, eye bolts etc.) are to be inspected before use, suitably marked with its safe working load and have a unique identify number. Damaged lifting accessories aretoberemovedfromservice andreturned to thestoreforrepair or tobedestroyed.
- Lifting accessories when not in use are tobe suitably stored and not left in a place where they are exposed to the elements or can be easily damage.
- Slinger/signalers (riggers) are to be trained and competent and check all lifting accessories and the security of the load before lifting. The level of assessment and certification of each rigger should be demonstrable at sitevia third part certificate,competence/training card etc.
- Before any lift takes place the ground conditions are to be assessed to ensure it is capable of taking the imposed load and a check is to be made to ensure there are no voids, tunnels, shafts, recently dug ground etc. Outriggers are to be deployed in accordance with the designated lift plan and/or the manufacturer's instructions.
- Suitable arrangements are to be in place so that the crane operator, slinger/signaler and supervisor are able to communicate with each other.
- Personnel are to be prevented from entering the lifting zone and no loads are to be lifted directly over personnel. Lifting zones are to be cordoned off using as a minimum soft barriers and warning signs displayed.
- Lifting operation is to be suspended during inclement weather when wind speeds reach 32kph (20mph) or in accordance with manufacturer's recommendations.
- When there is ariskof contactwith overhead electricalpowerlines thework area is tobeprotected asshownin OverheadPowerLinessection of thisdocument.
- Loads are to be controlled by use of tag lines and slinger/signalers are to keep body parts especially toes/feet/hands/fingers clear of anyload.
- A method statement and lift plan is requiredfor all liftingoperations.

## 3.14. Tower Cranes

- Effective planning of a tower crane erection,dismantling or alteration is essentialif the operation is to proceed safely, effectively and without incident. As part of the planning process a risk assessment is tobe carried out toidentifythehazards associatedwith theproposed operation.
- Once the risk assessment has been carried out,the appointed person should ensure that afull method statement document is prepared, detailing the safe system of workfor the installation operation.
- Siting of the tower cranes should take account of all the factors that could affect its safe operation, in particular the following:
- ·The crane standing and support conditions
- Thepresenceandproximityofotherhazards
